DECISION: Do not merge founder's branch. Use commit 296c934 contents as a feature spec.

WHAT'S IN IT:
- Org admin calendar (CompanyTvarkarastis.tsx) — 1,796 lines, 40+ useState, any types everywhere
- Org admin waitlist (665 lines)
- Platform admin expansion (+702 lines)
- Org suspension system
- Feature gate system (FeatureGate component)
- Parent no-show email notification (no auth)
- Bulk invoice creation
- Org tutor data visibility utilities (orgContactVisibility.ts, orgTutorLessonEdit.ts — actually clean)

WHY NOT MERGE:
- 21 migrations with same RLS policies rewritten 5-6 times (classic Cursor 'fix the fix' chain)
- Timestamp collision with our 20260327000001 migration
- 3 direct overlaps with our migrations
- One destructive DELETE on lesson_packages
- One data leak: get_student_profiles() lets any auth user query any user's data
- notify-session-no-show.ts has zero auth
- admin-organizations.ts 'protected' by VITE_ADMIN_SECRET bundled in frontend JS

SALVAGEABLE IDEAS (reimplement cleanly):
- Org admin calendar concept
- Org suspension mechanism
- Parent no-show notifications
- Granular lesson-edit permissions
- orgContactVisibility.ts and orgTutorLessonEdit.ts patterns
